title: Natural voice (Kokoro neural TTS)
summary: Chatbot-quality voices on the device (Kokoro 82M). Speaks streamed LLM output sentence by sentence while it is still generating.
limits: One-time ~370 MB download, then offline. Ask before downloading (use the models recipe).
Languages: US/UK English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese. Others (Czech, German, Japanese …) need tts.
mocks: window.__mocks.neuralTts = { downloaded, fail }; speaks through the browser voice
